synthesis.body: A pack version bump is never one file, and the file set depends on the pack's distribution route. Every pack bumps packs/<pack>/pack.toml and packs/<pack>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json together, and every bump also needs a docs/product/changelog.md entry in the same PR -- that obligation is stated in the changelog's own header, and by RFC-0095. A pack listed in the root .claude-plugin/marketplace.json bumps that too, making four files. A repo-scope pack is NOT listed there -- the Claude plugin marketplace is the user-profile install route -- so its bump is three files and there is no marketplace entry to update. Re-verified 2026-09-17: of 24 packs, 23 ship a plugin.json and eight of those have no marketplace entry -- _example, catalogue-curation, core, governance-extras, iac-terraform, monorepo-extras, release-engineering and user-guide-diataxis. Looking for a marketplace entry for one of those wastes the search. Enforcement is uneven, which is why the file set has to be known rather than discovered: CAT-V-005 catches a pack.toml/plugin.json mismatch so make build-check fails, marketplace.json staleness is caught only by the agentbundle pytest suite, and the changelog obligation is a convention gate. FORCE=1 make build-self projects pack CONTENT into .claude/ and .agents/ but propagates no version, so it repairs none of these. Determine the pack's route first, then bump its set by hand in one commit.

title: A pack version bump spans three or four files; build-self syncs none of them
